Posting a comment publishes the `comment.created` event from `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`, via `emit("comment.created", …)` at line 77. Four source files register a handler for it with `subscribe("comment.created", …)`:

- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts:198`: records an activity entry. It is wired up through `registerActivityListeners()`.
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts:150`: indexes the comment for search. It is wired up through `registerSearchListeners()`.
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts:203`: sends `comment_created` notifications to the issue's watchers. This one registers itself when the module is first imported; `event-registry.ts` just imports the file.
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts:120`: sends the event on to webhooks. It is wired up through `registerWebhookListeners()`.

I left out these files:
- `src/lib/event-bus.ts` is the bus itself.
- `src/server/services/event-registry.ts` only calls the register functions above. The one handler it defines itself listens for `digest.due`.
- These only declare or label the event name: `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts` and `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`.
- The subscriptions under `tests/` are in test code, not application source.

ANSWER: src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts
